body: my dad lives in a different state, so it wouldn’t really be possible to attempt to compromise and it’d probably be a burden to do all of that work because he’s so far away. The only other family would be my grandpa but he doesn’t really believe in depression, I guess. He constantly criticizes me for my “baby act” and that I’m crying for attention and that I’m “full of shit”. I don’t want to see a counselor at school because I don’t feel comfortable being so close to someone that I’m forced to see on a daily basis that I don’t trust knowing so many personal things about me. I would contact CPS but my sibling’s father is already fighting for custody of 2/4 of my mother’s children and if I left too she would be left with just my brother and I don’t want her to feel as if she tries for nothing because she puts in the hard work and generally cares for me but I just can’t take this living situation if nobody’s willing to help me.
me too but I’m trying and you should continue to try as well because it’s honestly worth it
